summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 30 yen per share from 25 yen, and year-end dividend forecast increased to 30 yen from 25 yen, bringing full-year dividend to 60 yen, reflecting upward revision of fiscal 2027 earnings driven by strong AI-related semiconductor demand.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Full-Year Business Forecast, Decision on Interim Dividend (Dividend Increase) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Toyo Gosei announced increases to both interim and year-end dividend forecasts for fiscal year 2027 ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend was raised to 30 yen per share from the previously announced 25 yen per share, with the dividend record date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 4, 2026. The company simultaneously revised upward its year-end dividend forecast to 30 yen per share from 25 yen, bringing the total annual dividend to 60 yen, compared to 40 yen in the prior fiscal year.

The dividend increases reflect the company's upward revision of full-year earnings guidance. The company now forecasts operating profit of 6,500 million yen versus the previous forecast of 5,800 million yen, an increase of 12.1 percent. Net income is forecast at 4,700 million yen, up 23.7 percent from the prior projection of 3,800 million yen, with earnings per share rising to 592.18 yen from 478.79 yen.

The earnings improvement stems from semiconductor-related demand exceeding initial expectations, particularly in advanced logic semiconductors and memory, driven by expansion of data center investments for generative AI. The company has expanded supply through previously undertaken production capacity enhancements. Sales growth in advanced photoresist materials for the photosensitive materials segment and high-purity solvents in the chemical products segment contributed to increased profitability. Management stated that advanced semiconductor-related demand is expected to remain robust going forward, supporting continued favorable sales trends.
